name: compliance_agent
description: Evaluates regulatory compliance of the selected CAPAs against severity-based rules and generates human-readable summaries using AWS Bedrock (Meta Llama 3.1 8B). Must be called last, after capa_agent.

skills.name: run_compliance_evaluation
skills.description: Evaluate regulatory compliance of CAPA actions against deterministic severity rules (PASS/FAIL) and generate concise summaries of preventive and corrective actions using AWS Bedrock LLM. Requires the CAPA output S3 bucket and key. Returns a compliance output S3 URI with per-sensor PASS/FAIL status and recommendations. Call this last, after capa_agent.
